notes.title: The Sylvia Drake Plush is Here!
notes.content:
We've been teasing it here and there, but with all the Felicias safely delivered to their new homes, we thought it was the perfect opportunity to launch the third Makeship plush from Mice Tea!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642965/df44830d4e6794d1da6e1569593aa3461b7f1440.gif[/img]

[h1][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/sylvia-drake]Click here to order your Sylvia Drake Plush![/url][/h1]

Once again we need 200 orders in the next two weeks to make this plush a reality.

Like Felicia, Sylvia comes with velcro patches for both holding her own cup of tea and for hand holding! You can match Sylvia up with Margaret, Felicia, or even the forbidden snake/cat/mouse polycule!

Remember, this will be your only opportunity to order this plush. Make sure to grab one in the next couple weeks if you want your very own snake wife!

notes.title: The Felicia Plushie is Here
notes.content:
It's been a long wait since we announced it, and an even longer wait since you got your Margaret plushes, but the Felicia plush is finally here!

[h1][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/felicia-banks-plushie]You can order yours at Makeship right now for delivery this March![/url][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642965/d6dd3f2a3d0f3c327a565668258c3dba61faee24.png[/img]

Just like last time, this is a limited run, so the next three weeks will be your only chance to order your plush!

And if you already have a Margaret plush, you can make them hold hands using their velcro patches! Now your OTP will never be apart again!

notes.title: The Margaret Plushie is for Sale!
notes.content:
[h1][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/margaret-de-campos-plushie]The Margaret de Campos Plushie is now available for sale at Makeship![/url][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642965/bbb8c5f844e293e6881d32f238bbbeddc84fc68f.png[/img]

For the next three weeks--now through Valentine's Day--you can order your own mouse girlfriend to take home!

Some of you might have already pre-ordered a plush during our initial, preliminary campaign, and those orders will still be honored, but for those of you who haven't had the opportunity to order, you can get yours now!

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/margaret-de-campos-plushie]Order yours now for fulfillment in May of this year![/url]

notes.title: Preorder your Margaret Plushie!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642965/6ce9e54954cb66592c7d917ca1e1895f459552c4.png[/img]

The rumors are true! Cinnamon Switch has teamed up with Makeship to offer a Margaret Plushie!

[h3][url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/margaret-de-campos-plushie]Click here to preorder with a $2 Pledge![/url][/h3]

The initial campaign lasts only one week and requires us to get 200 pledges, so we need everyone who wants to get a plush to pledge soon. The campaign ends after midnight on Sunday.

This is likely the only chance we'll have to make a stuffed figure of a Mice Tea character, and if the Margaret campaign goes well, more characters could be possible

[h3][url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/margaret-de-campos-plushie]Make sure to reserve your Margaret plush today!
[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642965/dce53b85c923aadb136368b4c6ee4b6f531d1203.png[/img] 

[h2]Here's an Q&A if you'd like:[/h2]

[b]Q:[/b] How much is this going to cost?  
[b]A:[/b] $30, and your $2 will be applied to that, so they'll only charge you the final $28 when they start making them.

[b]Q:[/b] Don't Makeship campaigns usually have a photo of the plush?  
[b]A:[/b] This is a new campaign type Makeship is trying out for smaller outfits like us. The real design will be as close to the above design as possible.

[b]Q:[/b] There's only a week to get 200 sales?  
[b]A:[/b] Yep, it's a tight window, but we hope you'll help us achieve it! There will actually be a second campaign if the intial one works with a prototype plushie and everything where we'll try to get more people to buy one, but the production will be guaranteed at that point

[b]Q:[/b] When will I get my plushie?  
[b]A:[/b] 3 to 6 months from now
